result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example. The existing tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` ran without errors, but I didn't run the full suite.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the per-quarter report uses, and updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". The ordering and the zero-count reps are unchanged.

`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` has the same gap, and I left it alone because it wasn't part of the task.
